description: A highly contagious liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus.
causes: Ingesting contaminated food or water, or close contact with an infected person.
prevention: Hepatitis A vaccine and good hygiene.
treatment_action: Rest, fluids, and managing symptoms. It usually resolves on its own.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A serious liver infection caused by the hepatitis B virus.
causes: Contact with infected blood, semen, or other body fluids.
prevention: Hepatitis B vaccine and safe practices.
treatment_action: Antiviral medications for chronic cases; acute cases may not need treatment.
complications: Cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver failure.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A viral infection that causes liver inflammation, sometimes leading to serious liver damage.
causes: Contact with infected blood, often through sharing needles.
prevention: Avoid sharing needles and practice safe behaviors.
treatment_action: Antiviral medications can cure most cases.
complications: Cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver failure.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A viral infection that causes sores on the mouth or genitals.
prevention: Avoid direct contact with sores and practice safe sex.
complications: Spread to other parts of the body and increased risk of STIs.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: HIV is a virus that attacks the immune system; AIDS is the most severe stage of HIV infection.
causes: Contact with infected blood, semen, or vaginal fluids.
prevention: Safe sex, PrEP, and not sharing needles.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A type of cancer that affects the lymphatic system.
causes: Genetic mutations in white blood cells.
prevention: No known way to prevent Hodgkin's lymphoma.
treatment_action: Chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and stem cell transplant.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An inherited disease that causes the progressive breakdown of nerve cells in the brain.
prevention: Genetic counseling for those with a family history.
treatment_action: Medications to manage movement and psychiatric symptoms.
complications: Pneumonia, injuries from falls, and complications from inability to swallow.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.
causes: Lifestyle factors, genetics, and underlying conditions.
prevention: Healthy diet, regular exercise, and limiting salt/alcohol.
complications: Heart attack, stroke, and kidney disease.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition in which the thyroid gland produces too much of the hormone thyroxine.
causes: Graves' disease, thyroid nodules, or thyroiditis.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but early diagnosis is helpful.
treatment_action: Anti-thyroid medications, radioactive iodine, or surgery.
complications: Heart problems, brittle bones, and eye problems.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition in which the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone.
causes: Autoimmune disease (Hashimoto's), treatment for hyperthyroidism, or radiation therapy.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but iodine in diet is important.
treatment_action: Daily use of synthetic thyroid hormone.
complications: Goiter, heart problems, and mental health issues.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
